name: orca-skills
description: Skills that add a GitHub-Issues backlog and planning layer on top of the Orca app — migrate a repo's tracking onto the model, triage raw issues into plannable ones, plan work adversarially, launch it as a lane with an agent already working, watch the lanes, and gate the result against the issue's own acceptance checklist. Requires Orca.
